newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM to trial Cargo Express from July.
newsitem.headline: KLM to trial Cargo Express from July.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV Cargo will launch a new trial express service in July for shipments under 30 kilogram, a KLM Cargo spokesman said.
Initially called KLM Cargo Express, the new service will be tested for six months in six stations including Amsterdam, Brussels, London, New York, Dubai and Johannesburg, he added.

The new airport-to-airport product is from KLM Cargo's Air Mail Services Business Unit. It will be possible to deliver cargo one hour before departure and pick-up in one hour after arrival, said the spokesman.
Restrictions exist concerning the size of the shipments. For instance shipments may not be more than 1.50 metres total in length and more than 4cm wide and 4cm high, said the spokesman

KLM Cargo also has Document Express which is for documents under 2.5 kilogram which must be in standard envelopes and not contain anything of value for the customs authorities. This covers KLM's whole network whereas the new express service will be reserved for important destinations. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
